tutorial.title: Tutorial - Welcome
lines: Welcome to Dysbarism! You control a submarine
in a dangerous underwater world, searching for
the legendary city of Euthalassa.

tutorial.title: Tutorial - Overworld
lines: The game has two main views: Overworld and Combat.
In the Overworld, you'll explore, find resources,
and encounter enemies or friendly outposts.

tutorial.title: Tutorial - Navigation
lines: NAVIGATION: In the Overworld, RIGHT-CLICK on
the map to move your submarine to that location.
Moving consumes FUEL, shown in your status panel.

tutorial.title: Tutorial - Sonar
lines: SONAR: Press SPACEBAR to ping your radar and
reveal nearby points of interest. Be careful -
pinging attracts enemies to your location!

tutorial.title: Tutorial - Status Panel
lines: STATUS PANEL: The UI shows your submarine's
ARMOR (top/bottom/left/right), FUEL level,
and MONEY. Monitor these resources carefully!

tutorial.title: Tutorial - Nodes
lines: NODES: Colored circles on the map are interaction
points. There are 3 types of coloured nodes:
Red, green and blue.

tutorial.title: Tutorial - Help
lines: Red: 100% an enemy
Green: A wreckage event, or a city to upgrade stuff.
Blue: A supply node brimming with resources

tutorial.title: Tutorial - Help
lines: Note that sonar in the world of Dysbarism isn't
always reliable. Just because it's not red doesn't
mean it can't be an enemy...

tutorial.title: Tutorial - Combat Basics
lines: COMBAT: When encountering enemies, you'll enter
combat mode. Use WASD keys to maneuver your
submarine and avoid enemy attacks.

tutorial.title: Tutorial - Weapons
lines: WEAPONS: LEFT-CLICK fires your primary weapon.
RIGHT-CLICK fires your secondary weapon.
Different weapons work better against different enemies.

tutorial.title: Tutorial - Combat Area
lines: COMBAT AREA: Battles occur in a limited area
marked by warning triangles. Leaving this area
will push you back into the combat zone.

tutorial.title: Tutorial - Victory & Rewards
lines: VICTORY: Defeat all enemies to win combat.
You'll earn MONEY that can be spent at cities
for repairs, fuel, and upgrades.

tutorial.title: Tutorial - City Nodes
lines: CITIES: Visit green city nodes to repair your
submarine, refuel, and receive information
about your journey to Euthalassa.

tutorial.title: Tutorial - Goal
lines: GOAL: Navigate through increasingly dangerous
waters, following clues from city to city to
discover the mythical city of Euthalassa.

tutorial.title: Tutorial - Help
lines: HELP: Press the ? button anytime to view this tutorial.
Press ESC to access the menu.
Good luck on your journey, submariner!
